criteria.description: CoreDNS backend maps FQDNs to reverse-label etcd keys under /skydns by default.
SyncZone replaces the target zone snapshot and removes prior keys in that zone.
ListRecords decodes CoreDNS service JSON for A, AAAA, and CNAME records.
Zone replacement is prefix-scoped and does not delete sibling zone records.
DNS config validation accepts coredns backends with non-empty etcd_endpoints and defaults empty etcd_prefix to /skydns.
